quantize_and_save_gguf: use AutoRound to quantize a model and save it in gguf:q4_0 format
save_quantized_gguf_format: call save_quantized with format gguf:q4_1 to export a quantized model as GGUF
create_tiny_model: use save_tiny_model to create a small subset model with 2 layers for testing
evaluate_quantized_accuracy: call evaluate_accuracy on a quantized model with a threshold and piqa task
inspect_gguf_tensors: use GGUFReader to read a GGUF file and inspect tensor names and types
